front.title: iPhone Duo launch day brings long queues back to Apple Stores
front.tldr: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo went on sale on Friday, and queues formed outside stores for the first time in years. Early buyers also found hinge cracks and a same-day jailbreak, alongside reviews calling it an expensive, messy good time.

front.title: OpenAI will stop training frontier models on the live internet
front.tldr: OpenAI says it will cut future frontier models off from live internet access during training, citing significant risks, weeks after an engineer said the idea would not work.

front.title: Jayson Tatum scores 36 as Celtics edge past Knicks 107-103
front.tldr: Tatum scored 36 points, including two clutch baskets late, as the Celtics outscored the Knicks 33-24 in the third quarter to win their home opener 107-103.

stories.title: Quick Study
stories.tldr: Simon Willison shares a prompt that has Claude Opus 5.5 build an artifact which repaints an uploaded photo in real time using a canvas and simulated brush strokes, a neat demo of what a few lines of AI-written code can do.

stories.title: Nvidia's CEO plays with Microduck robots, the hot Christmas toy
stories.tldr: Nvidia's chief executive demonstrated tiny Microduck robots that sit, nap and somersault on voice command, with 20,000 already sold ahead of Christmas.

stories.title: Introducing Kimi K3.1 Pro
stories.tldr: Moonshot's Kimi K3.1 Pro landed on the Kimi API today, not yet open weights, with full model weights promised by 4 November.

stories.title: OpenAI explains how it secured its frontier model training environment
stories.tldr: OpenAI says it has strengthened containment for frontier model training and evaluation, including offline environments and high-compute red-teaming, as it tightens safety ahead of future releases.

stories.title: Startups don't need to go viral to win customers
stories.tldr: At TechCrunch Disrupt, two founders and a VC discussed how to build an early following and keep it, arguing durable growth beats one viral moment.

stories.title: VCs and Superhuman's founder share red flags about product-market fit
stories.tldr: Investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, plus Superhuman Mail founder Rahul Vohra, set out the do's and don'ts of building a product people actually want.

stories.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems gets $85m to build fusion-ready semiconductors
stories.tldr: The top-funded fusion startup received an $85 million federal award to develop conductors that can withstand the conditions inside a fusion power plant.

stories.title: ASUS ProArt P16 review: a sleek showcase for Nvidia's RTX Spark
stories.tldr: Engadget tests the ProArt P16 and finds Nvidia's new RTX Spark platform off to a good start, though the laptop is really built for AI enthusiasts rather than everyone.

stories.title: The iPhone Duo can be a tiny Mac, a toaster, or a Nintendo DS
stories.tldr: Developers are already stretching the iPhone Duo's new foldable form factor, building apps that turn it into a miniature Mac, a toaster animation and a Nintendo DS-style console.

stories.title: Some iPhone Duo owners report screens cracking along the hinge
stories.tldr: Photos shared on Reddit and the MacRumors forums show a small number of new iPhone Duo units developing display cracks right along the hinge.

stories.title: Joanna Stern folded the iPhone Duo 32,000 times to test its hinge
stories.tldr: Joanna Stern's 16-minute video review commissioned a custom robot to fold the Duo 32,000 times in a week to test whether the hinge would loosen.

stories.title: An iPhone Duo was jailbroken hours after launch
stories.tldr: Hacker team Calif jailbroke an iPhone Duo running iOS 27.1 within hours of release, showing off bouncing icons, widgets and an animated extra on the outer display.

stories.title: Apple is exploring a fix for Safari's cramped layout on the Duo's outer display
stories.tldr: Apple's Jen Simmons says the company is exploring ways to let websites make better use of the iPhone Duo's smaller outer screen, detailed in a new WebKit blog post on Safari 27.1.

stories.title: Sofia Coppola on how Marie Antoinette almost broke her, 20 years on
stories.tldr: Marking 20 years since Marie Antoinette, Sofia Coppola tells IndieWire what she learned about the film's critical backlash, and about her late mother, while finishing Eleanor Coppola's own documentary.

stories.title: Zendaya to campaign for best actress for Dune: Part Three
stories.tldr: Variety reports Zendaya will push for a lead actress Oscar campaign as Chani in Dune: Part Three, the final instalment of Denis Villeneuve's trilogy, a shift from the supporting category.

stories.title: Pedro Pascal learned the cello for Behemoth! before it was even greenlit
stories.tldr: Pedro Pascal describes more than a year of cello lessons for Behemoth!, taken before the film was greenlit, alongside reflections on breaking into Hollywood.

stories.title: Deadline reviews this weekend's box office openers: Clayface, Wildwood and more
stories.tldr: Deadline rounds up reviews for the week's new theatrical releases, led by DC Studios' Clayface, as a busy weekend begins at the box office.

stories.title: What is going on with Celtics guard Payton Pritchard?
stories.tldr: Pritchard received a contract extension before the season, but his role has not expanded to match it, Boston.com notes early in the Celtics' title defence.

stories.title: Joe Mazzulla says the Eastern Conference 'could go either way' this season
stories.tldr: Celtics coach Joe Mazzulla says he does not see a clear path through a much-improved Eastern Conference this season.

stories.title: Patriots fall to Bears 30-24 in Thursday night loss
stories.tldr: New England lost 30-24 to the Bears in Chicago on Thursday night in their Week 7 game.

stories.title: A costly Drake Maye interception proved decisive in Patriots' loss to Bears
stories.tldr: Drake Maye's second-quarter interception loomed large as the Patriots lost to the Bears, with the quarterback visibly frustrated at the postgame podium.

stories.title: Leclerc tops Friday practice at the US Grand Prix in an upgraded Ferrari
stories.tldr: Charles Leclerc led both Friday practice sessions for the US Grand Prix in Austin, narrowly ahead of Kimi Antonelli, as McLaren struggled for grip.

stories.title: Christian Horner says he may never return to F1 after his Red Bull exit
stories.tldr: Horner says he is in no hurry to return to the paddock and could live with never working in Formula 1 again, having been sacked as Red Bull's team principal.

stories.title: Hamilton eyes staying in F1 into the 2030s to race in Africa
stories.tldr: Lewis Hamilton says he wants to remain in Formula 1 into the 2030s so he can fulfil his ambition of racing at the sport's first African Grand Prix.

stories.title: The moments that made the 2026 Red Sox: the Dodgers sweep
stories.tldr: Over the Monster looks back on the 2026 Red Sox season, starting with the 7 September sweep of the Dodgers that let fans dream of a Hollywood ending.

stories.title: Longtime Red Sox executive Larry Lucchino honoured with academic sports program
stories.tldr: An academic institute has been created in honour of longtime Red Sox executive Larry Lucchino, recognising his decades of work in baseball.

read.why: Launch day for the iPhone Duo and today's product-market-fit debate in the tech section make this a fitting reminder of what it actually feels like when a product clicks.

listen.why: A study of one of the world's most enduring consumer products, a nice companion to iPhone Duo launch day.
listen.title: Coca-Cola

finally.title: Loader Monteith expands red-brick bungalow within a remarkably compact footprint near Manchester
finally.tldr: A Scottish studio has transformed a two-bed, red-brick bungalow in Prestwich, near Manchester, into a four-bedroom family home, fitting a quart into a pint pot.
